title: Nesthy Petecio bows out of Asian Games, says family will carry legacy

blocks.text: NAGOYA—Nesthy Petecio left her third Asian Games without a medal on Monday. Still, the two-time Olympic medalist believes her family’s presence in Philippine boxing will continue long after she hangs up her gloves. Petecio lost to China’s Yang Chengyu in the quarterfinals of the women’s 60-kilogram division, ending another attempt to add an Asian Games medal to her decorated career. “If I’m no longer able to compete in the Asian Games and win a medal, my brother Norlan is here to continue what I’ve started,” Petecio said in Filipino.
